    """Convert minutes after midnight to zero‑padded 'HH:MM'."""
    return f"{m // 60:02d}:{m % 60:02d}"

def intervals_overlap(a_start, a_end, b_start, b_end) -> bool:
    """True if half‑open intervals [a_start,a_end) and [b_start,b_end) overlap."""
    return a_start < b_end and b_start < a_end

work_end   = hm_to_min("17:00")
duration   = 30  # minutes

    "Monday": [

    ],

        ("10:30", "11:30"),
        ("12:30", "13:30"),
        ("14:30", "15:30"),
        ("16:00", "17:00"),

    harold_blocks[day] = [(hm_to_min(s), hm_to_min(e)) for s, e in harold_blocks[day]]

    # iterate over every possible start minute within work hours
